en: A black-and-white aerial view of a European town nestled along a winding river, surrounded by mountains. The town features orderly rows of buildings, roads, some notable larger structures, green open spaces, and tree-lined streets. The edges of the postcard have wide borders, typical of early to mid-20th century photographic postcards. No visible text or labels can be seen on the image side.
